offering_description.value: The company sells high-protein snacks, low-carbohydrate foods, and ready-to-drink protein shakes. It develops and markets the products, uses contract manufacturers, and sells through retailers and online channels.

primary_products.value: protein bars; ready-to-drink protein shakes; protein chips; protein cookies; low-carbohydrate candies

customer_segment.value: B2B: Grocery chains, mass merchants, warehouse clubs, convenience stores, drugstores, and online retailers; B2C: Consumers buying high-protein snacks, low-carbohydrate foods, or plant-based shakes

end_markets.value: packaged snacks; sports and active nutrition; weight management; plant-based nutrition

revenue_model.value: product sales: Packaged snacks and shakes sold to retailers and consumers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops snacks and shakes, contracts out production, and sells finished products to retailers and consumers

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily the United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: High-protein snacks, low-carbohydrate foods, and dairy-based and plant-based protein shakes

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Grocery stores, mass merchants, warehouse clubs, drugstores, and convenience stores; online: Brand websites, online marketplaces, and retailer websites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food safety, nutrition labeling, allergen disclosure, and food claims rules

notes: The current extent of sales outside North America is uncertain.
